parameters: (*Huff, huff*...! *Wheeze*...!)
(Shit! Why did the trains have to be late today
of all days!? I'm barely in time for the flight!
Curse you, you damn stupid accidents!)
(She might already be on board by now...)

\n<???>Heeey! \N[1], over here!
\n<\N[1]>Hazuki!
\n<\N[2]>You're so incredibly late! I've been waiting
for so long... I thought you'd never come!
\n<\N[2]>You're lucky though! The previous flight's landing
was delayed, so mine got delayed too. They're going
to start boarding soon!
\n<\N[1]>Oh, I s-see! Looks like I made it just in time then.
\n<\N[2]>Nope, I'm sorry! I just can't do it! I didn't want
to cry... I wanted this to be a happy goodbye.
\n<\N[2]>It's just that... being separated like this is hard.
\n<\N[1]>I'll be waiting for you right here, Hazuki! And I'll
be eager to hear from you about how great your
new overseas job is.
\n<\N[1]>One day, you'll come back to me.
\n<\N[2]>Hehe! Yeah, you're right.
\n<\N[2]>Just you wait! I'll make a name for myself over
there, and I'll come back a winner! Then, we'll
finally start building our life together.
\n<\N[1]>O-Of course! I can't wait!!

Hazuki and I were in love with each other. Distance
can't separate what destiny has brought together.
I helped my love reach for her dreams and supported
her all the way. I was there at the airport to see her
off with all my blessings.
I could see then that my plan had been utter madness.
And yet, despite not carrying it out, I finally had a girlfriend.
Hazuki was the one, the person I loved most in the world.
There probably wouldn't be someone else I'd love like her again.
Now a wall called "distance" stands between us.
But I believe we'll be able to overcome it together.
